name: Budding cumulus
production: Cloud → Base + Shoulders + Root → PrimaryBud → FlankBuds → SummitBud → UnionBoundary → Backing + Face
rules: Base and original shoulders remain fixed throughout growth.
A bud starts inside its parent, expands locally and emerges; later buds attach to earlier buds.
Activation uses smoothstep; lobe radius begins at zero without a popping detached piece.
Mature lobes keep their radius. There is no growth-dependent coordinate scale or aspect ratio.
Analytic intersections retain only exposed arcs and base edges, merging all masses into one cut.
One fixed uniform scale is used for every stage; the base datum never moves.
This is an art grammar, not a physical cloud simulation.
Parent offsets are fractions of the current parent radius; newborn buds begin inside the parent rather than forming small exterior warts.
The merged silhouette fills enclosed interior pockets; detached outer components are rejected.
